title: CrewAI CLI Commands
summary: This module provides a comprehensive set of command-line interface (CLI) commands for managing CrewAI projects, including operations for checkpoints, deployments, tools, flows, configurations, and tracing. It serves as the primary interface for interacting with CrewAI functionalities.

nodes.label: CrewAI CLI Main Entry
nodes.title: CrewAI CLI Main Entry
nodes.description: The main entry point for all CrewAI command-line interface operations, providing access to various subcommands for managing projects, deployments, tools, and configurations.

nodes.label: Resume CrewAI Checkpoint
nodes.title: Resume CrewAI Checkpoint
nodes.description: Resumes a CrewAI execution from a specified checkpoint ID, or the most recent one if not specified, allowing continuation of previous work.

nodes.label: Compare Checkpoints
nodes.title: Compare Checkpoints
nodes.description: Compares the state and content of two CrewAI checkpoints, highlighting differences for analysis and debugging.

nodes.label: Display Checkpoint Details
nodes.title: Display Checkpoint Details
nodes.description: Displays detailed information about a specific CrewAI checkpoint, including its path, ID, and metadata.

nodes.label: List All Checkpoints
nodes.title: List All Checkpoints
nodes.description: Lists all available checkpoints within a specified directory, providing an overview of saved execution states.

nodes.label: Remove Old Checkpoints
nodes.title: Remove Old Checkpoints
nodes.description: Removes older or unwanted checkpoints based on criteria like age or number to keep, helping manage storage.

nodes.label: Retrieve Latest Task Outputs
nodes.title: Retrieve Latest Task Outputs
nodes.description: Retrieves and displays the outputs of the latest tasks from a CrewAI kickoff, useful for reviewing recent execution results.

nodes.label: Start Interactive Chat
nodes.title: Start Interactive Chat
nodes.description: Initiates an interactive chat session with the Crew, enabling real-time communication and response generation using the Chat LLM.

nodes.label: Create New Tool
nodes.title: Create New Tool
nodes.description: Generates the boilerplate for a new custom tool, facilitating the development of specialized functionalities for agents.

nodes.label: Install Custom Tool
nodes.title: Install Custom Tool
nodes.description: Installs a specified custom tool, making it available for use within CrewAI projects.

nodes.label: Publish Custom Tool
nodes.title: Publish Custom Tool
nodes.description: Publishes a custom tool, making it accessible for sharing and wider adoption within the CrewAI ecosystem.

nodes.label: Deploy CrewAI Project
nodes.title: Deploy CrewAI Project
nodes.description: Deploys the current CrewAI project to a remote platform, pushing the latest changes for execution.

nodes.label: Create New Deployment
nodes.title: Create New Deployment
nodes.description: Initializes a new deployment for a CrewAI project, setting up the necessary infrastructure on a remote platform.

nodes.label: List All Deployments
nodes.title: List All Deployments
nodes.description: Lists all active deployments associated with the user's CrewAI account, providing an overview of running projects.

nodes.label: Get Deployment Status
nodes.title: Get Deployment Status
nodes.description: Retrieves and displays the current operational status of a specific CrewAI deployment, indicating its health and activity.

nodes.label: Retrieve Deployment Logs
nodes.title: Retrieve Deployment Logs
nodes.description: Fetches and displays the execution logs for a specified CrewAI deployment, aiding in debugging and monitoring.

nodes.label: Remove Deployment
nodes.title: Remove Deployment
nodes.description: Deactivates and removes an existing CrewAI deployment from the remote platform, cleaning up resources.

nodes.label: Execute CrewAI Project
nodes.title: Execute CrewAI Project
nodes.description: Executes the CrewAI project, optionally using a file containing trained agents for enhanced performance.

nodes.label: Configure Enterprise Settings
nodes.title: Configure Enterprise Settings
nodes.description: Configures the CrewAI AMP OAuth2 settings using a provided enterprise URL, integrating with corporate authentication systems.

nodes.label: Test & Evaluate Crew
nodes.title: Test & Evaluate Crew
nodes.description: Runs a series of tests on the CrewAI project and evaluates the results, ensuring functionality and performance.

nodes.label: Validate Project for Deployment
nodes.title: Validate Project for Deployment
nodes.description: Performs pre-deployment checks on the current project to identify potential issues before actual deployment, without contacting the platform.

nodes.label: Run UV Package Manager
nodes.title: Run UV Package Manager
nodes.description: A wrapper around `uv` package manager commands, enhancing them with custom tool authentication through environment variables.

nodes.label: List CLI Configurations
nodes.title: List CLI Configurations
nodes.description: Displays all current configuration parameters for the CrewAI CLI, providing transparency into settings.

nodes.label: Set CLI Configuration
nodes.title: Set CLI Configuration
nodes.description: Sets a specific configuration parameter for the CrewAI CLI, allowing customization of behavior.

nodes.label: Reset CLI Configurations
nodes.title: Reset CLI Configurations
nodes.description: Resets all CrewAI CLI configuration parameters to their default values, restoring initial settings.

nodes.label: List Organizations
nodes.title: List Organizations
nodes.description: Lists all organizations associated with the user's CrewAI account, facilitating multi-organizational management.

nodes.label: Log Out from CrewAI AMP
nodes.title: Log Out from CrewAI AMP
nodes.description: Logs the user out from CrewAI AMP, optionally resetting all CLI configuration settings.

nodes.label: Enable Trace Collection
nodes.title: Enable Trace Collection
nodes.description: Activates the collection of execution traces for CrewAI projects, sending data to CrewAI+ for monitoring and analysis.

nodes.label: Disable Trace Collection
nodes.title: Disable Trace Collection
nodes.description: Deactivates the collection of execution traces for CrewAI projects, stopping data transmission to CrewAI+.

nodes.label: Train CrewAI Project
nodes.title: Train CrewAI Project
nodes.description: Initiates the training process for the CrewAI project over a specified number of iterations, improving agent performance.

nodes.label: Execute CrewAI Flow
nodes.title: Execute CrewAI Flow
nodes.description: Executes a defined CrewAI Flow, orchestrating tasks and agents according to the flow's logic.

nodes.label: Plot CrewAI Flow
nodes.title: Plot CrewAI Flow
nodes.description: Generates a visual representation or diagram of the CrewAI Flow, aiding in understanding its structure and execution path.

nodes.label: List Available Triggers
nodes.title: List Available Triggers
nodes.description: Lists all available triggers from integrated services, allowing users to see potential automation entry points.

nodes.label: Execute with Trigger Payload
nodes.title: Execute with Trigger Payload
nodes.description: Executes a CrewAI project using a specific trigger payload, enabling automated workflows based on external events.

nodes.label: Reset Crew Memories
nodes.title: Reset Crew Memories
nodes.description: Clears various types of stored memories for the crew, including long-term, short-term, entities, knowledge, and kickoff outputs.

nodes.label: Show Trace Collection Status
nodes.title: Show Trace Collection Status
nodes.description: Displays the current status of trace collection, indicating whether it's enabled or disabled and why.

nodes.label: Add Crew to Flow
nodes.title: Add Crew to Flow
nodes.description: Integrates an existing crew into a defined flow, expanding the flow's capabilities with additional agents and tasks.

nodes.label: List Project Templates
nodes.title: List Project Templates
nodes.description: Lists available project templates and allows selection for installation, streamlining new project creation.

nodes.label: Add Project Template
nodes.title: Add Project Template
nodes.description: Adds a specified project template to the current working directory, providing a starting structure for new crews.

nodes.label: Checkpoint CLI Module
nodes.title: Checkpoint CLI Module
nodes.description: Manages the underlying logic for CrewAI checkpoint operations, including saving, loading, and comparing states.

nodes.label: Tool Command Handler
nodes.title: Tool Command Handler
nodes.description: Provides core functionalities for managing custom tools, such as creation, installation, and publishing.

nodes.label: Deployment Command Handler
nodes.title: Deployment Command Handler
nodes.description: Encapsulates the logic for deploying, managing, and monitoring CrewAI projects on remote platforms.

nodes.label: Crew Execution Function
nodes.title: Crew Execution Function
nodes.description: Executes the main logic of a CrewAI project, orchestrating agents and tasks.

nodes.label: Enterprise Config Handler
nodes.title: Enterprise Config Handler
nodes.description: Handles the configuration of enterprise-level authentication and integration settings for CrewAI AMP.

nodes.label: Crew Evaluation Function
nodes.title: Crew Evaluation Function
nodes.description: Performs evaluation of a CrewAI project's performance and results against defined metrics.

nodes.label: Deployment Validation Function
nodes.title: Deployment Validation Function
nodes.description: Executes a series of validation checks to ensure a CrewAI project is ready for deployment.

nodes.label: Subprocess Execution Module
nodes.title: Subprocess Execution Module
nodes.description: A standard Python module used to spawn new processes, connect to their input/output/error pipes, and obtain their return codes.

nodes.label: CLI Settings Handler
nodes.title: CLI Settings Handler
nodes.description: Manages the persistent configuration settings for the CrewAI CLI, allowing users to customize their environment.

nodes.label: Organization Command Handler
nodes.title: Organization Command Handler
nodes.description: Handles operations related to managing organizations within the CrewAI platform, such as listing available organizations.

nodes.label: Application Settings Manager
nodes.title: Application Settings Manager
nodes.description: Manages application-wide settings and configurations, including user preferences and authentication details.

nodes.label: Authentication Token Manager
nodes.title: Authentication Token Manager
nodes.description: Manages authentication tokens for secure access to CrewAI services, handling storage, retrieval, and clearing.

nodes.label: User Data Update Function
nodes.title: User Data Update Function
nodes.description: Updates user-specific data, often related to telemetry consent or feature flags.

nodes.label: Crew Training Function
nodes.title: Crew Training Function
nodes.description: Implements the training loop for a CrewAI project, iteratively improving agent behavior.

nodes.label: Flow Kickoff Function
nodes.title: Flow Kickoff Function
nodes.description: Initiates the execution of a CrewAI Flow, starting the sequence of tasks and agent interactions.

nodes.label: Flow Plotting Function
nodes.title: Flow Plotting Function
nodes.description: Generates a visual diagram or graph of a CrewAI Flow's structure and dependencies.

nodes.label: Triggers Command Handler
nodes.title: Triggers Command Handler
nodes.description: Manages the integration and execution of external triggers for CrewAI projects, enabling event-driven workflows.

nodes.label: Memory Reset Function
nodes.title: Memory Reset Function
nodes.description: Performs the actual deletion or clearing of various memory types stored by the crew.

nodes.label: User Data Loading Function
nodes.title: User Data Loading Function
nodes.description: Loads persistent user data and preferences from storage.

nodes.label: Tracing Status Check Function
nodes.title: Tracing Status Check Function
nodes.description: Checks the current status of tracing, considering both user settings and environment variables.

nodes.label: Add Crew to Flow Function
nodes.title: Add Crew to Flow Function
nodes.description: Integrates a specified crew into an existing flow definition.

nodes.label: Template Command Handler
nodes.title: Template Command Handler
nodes.description: Manages operations related to project templates, including listing and adding them to projects.

nodes.label: Task Outputs Loader
nodes.title: Task Outputs Loader
nodes.description: Loads and retrieves the stored outputs from previous CrewAI task executions.

nodes.label: Chat Interface Runner
nodes.title: Chat Interface Runner
nodes.description: Manages the interactive chat interface for communicating with a CrewAI project.

nodes.label: TOML File Reader
nodes.title: TOML File Reader
nodes.description: Parses and reads data from a `pyproject.toml` file, typically for project configuration.

nodes.label: Tool Credentials Environment Builder
nodes.title: Tool Credentials Environment Builder
nodes.description: Constructs an environment variable dictionary including all necessary tool credentials for execution.
